Your vote in the US is one of the most meaningless in the developed world because of our voting system. Most of the developed world has moved onto various forms of proportional government whereby if a state has 100 seats and some group gets 5% of the vote, they get 5% of the seats. It results in the ability to actually get representatives into office who represent the people.

Compare this to what we do in America. Imagine a state has 100 representatives and is split evenly 30% democrat, 25% republican, 20% libertarian, 15% green, 10% other. What happens? You get 100 democrat representatives!! The state is broken up into 100 districts so we can awkwardly force plurality. The first district votes 30% democrat, 25% republican, 20% libertarian, etc. Democrats win. The same process repeats 99 more times. And even though they only have 30% of the support in the state, they get 100% of the representative seats. That is what we get in the United States with our vote.
